```json
  {"metric": "v_compliance", "op": "<=", "value": 0.25},
  {"metric": "rout", "op": ">=", "value": 7e6}
],
 "topology": "self-biased wide-swing NMOS cascode mirror (Sooch-type, series resistor sets cascode bias)",
 "rationale": "A simple mirror cannot reach 7 MOhm at 20 uA: that needs gm/gds > 2000. A cascode gives Rout ~ gm4*ro4*ro2 ~ 10+ MOhm. A series resistor R between the cascode gate and the bottom gate puts both bottom devices at VDS ~ I*R ~ 0.13 V. Compliance is then ~ VDS1 + Vdsat4 ~ 0.22 V. Both bottom devices see equal VDS, giving small systematic error. Moderate inversion (gm/Id ~ 18) keeps Vdsat ~ 0.1 V. L = 1 um gives ro and matching."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (16.0, 10.0, 22.0),    # bottom mirror devices gm/Id
    "L_b":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),       # bottom mirror L
    "gmid_c": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),    # cascode devices gm/Id
    "L_c":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # cascode L
    "vds_b":  (0.14, 0.09, 0.22),    # target VDS of bottom devices (sets R)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vdsb = p["vds_b"]

    # bottom pair (identical, ratio 1)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I, vds=vdsb)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], I, vds=vdsb)
    # cascode pair, source at vdsb -> include body effect
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vdsb, 0.15)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=vds3, vsb=vdsb)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=vout - vdsb, vsb=vdsb)

    # cascode gate = Vgs1 + I*R must equal vdsb + Vgs3
    R = max((vdsb + m3.vgs - m1.vgs) / I, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -> R -> drain of M3 (node nb = bottom gate bias)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "nb", R)
    n.dev("M3", "nb", "iin", "x1", "vss", m3)     # cascode, gate at iin (top of R)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "nb", "vss", "vss", m1)     # bottom, gate at nb
    # output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "x2", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "nb", "vss", "vss", m2)

    # predictions
    g2 = lut.op("n", m2.W, m2.L, m2.vgs, vdsb)["gds"]
    gds2 = max(g2, m2.gds)
    rout = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / (m4.gds * gds2) + 1.0 / m4.gds
    vcomp = vdsb + m4.vdsat
    # residual error: VDS mismatch of bottom devices from cascode drain difference
    dv = (vout - vdsb) - vds3
    dvx = dv * m4.gds / (m4.gm + m4.gmbs)
    err = 100.0 * dvx * gds2 / I
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": abs(err) + 0.2, "rout": rout,
               "v_compliance": vcomp, "power": I * 0.0}
```
